about_the_game:
You were sent to a strange, icy desert. But your employers had only told you part of the truth and what initially sounded like a difficult but well-paid job turned into a nightmare in which every decision you make can mean the difference between life and death.

  • Campaign: Lead your crew through numerous dangerous expeditions and experience a fascinating story. Each expedition is unique, multi-layered and spans several nights.

  • Tactical turn-based combat: Control multiple combat robots and defend your crew against monstrous dangers on expeditions.

  • Handcrafted characters: Your crew is not made up of random numbers. They all have their own history and morals. Not all of them will be happy with your decisions.

  • Permadeath: Whether human or machine, wrong decisions will result in you losing them forever.

  • Research and upgrades: Improve your station and your combat robots to better face the dangers of this brutal world.

  • Manage your crew: Decide how and where to deploy your crew to survive a balancing act between stress, fatigue and injuries.
